thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT — routing-service: sudden spike in quality regressions for /generate (prod). 5 customers reporting degraded outputs. Policy=price-led-fallback. See dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/routing/alerts/2213344556 :rotating_light:
Sam (oncall): seeing same on the dashboard, quality regression up to +23% classifier score drop, trace samples show cheap-variant-quantized is responding for many requests. Paging now.
Priya (ml-infra): on it. Can anyone confirm whether the recent routing-policy rollout (yesterday 22:00) touched price-led thresholds?
Liam (prod-eng): I merged a tweak to the routing optimizer last night to prefer lower-cost variants under budget cap, but it was gated. I did a canary but not full rollout — checking the deploy bot.
deploy-bot: release 2026.02.18-reroute-optimizer applied to cluster-routes-3 at 2026-02-18T22:03:12Z by liam_prod_eng.
Aisha (support): multiple customers called; one enterprise (acct: lambda-retail) seeing hallucinations in product descriptions. Customer thread in #support-private with logs.
Sam (oncall): quick mitigation proposal: disable price-led fallback on prod routing-policy, force-route traffic to stable-pinned variant (stable-v2.3) for affected customers, and collect new traces. I can execute if we agree.
Priya (ml-infra): agree. Also check if regional fallback to eu-cheap-node pool happened — telemetry shows traffic shifted to eu-west-1 cheap-pool for some us requests due to transient capacity. That could be coupling the price policy with region fallback.
Carlos (eng-mgr): Priya, Sam — take incident lead. Liam, log the PR and same-week revert plan. Maya, loop in customer success for impacted accounts.
Maya (cust-success): pinged lambda-retail and offered mitigation plan + incident update. They want ETA for rollback.
Sam (oncall): executing hotfix now:
```bash
# disable price-led fallback in routing service (hotpatch)
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \ 
  https://controlplane.internal/v1/policies/price-led-fallback/actions/disable \ 
  -d '{"env":"prod","reason":"quality-pager-2213344556"}'
```
Sam (oncall): controlplane responded 202 Accepted. Verifying route table flip...
deploy-bot: policy price-led-fallback disabled in prod by sam_oncall at 2026-02-19T00:08:45Z.
Priya (ml-infra): I'm forcing a routing override for affected routes to stable-v2.3 and pin variants for lambda-retail and a few others:
```json
{"route":"/generate","target_variant":"stable-v2.3","scope":["acct:lambda-retail","acct:beta-shop"]}
```
Priya (ml-infra): override applied, checking live traces.
Sam (oncall): traces look much better after override, classifier scores trending back toward baseline. I'll keep monitoring for 15m.
Aisha (support): updated customers. Lambda-retail confirms immediate improvement on sampled requests. They still want root cause and SLA impact numbers.
Liam (prod-eng): I see the variant selection logs — the optimizer decision matrix incorrectly prioritized a newly-introduced cost_score that had a very aggressive weight for small burst windows. I have a revert PR ready: revert r-4523 (optimizer weight adjustment).
Carlos (eng-mgr): schedule rollback after stabilization window. Priya, confirm no capacity pressure remains in eu cheap pool.
Priya (ml-infra): eu cheap pool CPU/GPU usage nominal now; the shift was triggered by a transient autoscaler hiccup + the aggressive cost weight. I've queued a follow-up to tighten region-fallback coupling in the routing policy.
Sam (oncall): handing off to Priya for next shift and to own post-mortem. I need to sleep; Sam out. :coffee:
Priya (ml-infra): taking over as incident lead. Next steps: 1) monitor for 60m, 2) trigger rollback PR r-4523 to revert weight change, 3) create an incident ticket with impact metrics.
Liam (prod-eng): PR merged as rollback r-4523-revert at 2026-02-19T00:27Z.
deploy-bot: rollback deployed to routing-optimizer at 2026-02-19T00:29Z.
Priya (ml-infra): routing optimizer rollback confirmed. Running regression check against synthetic prompt set (quality-e2e-main).
Priya (ml-infra): regression check shows quality metrics within baseline +/-2%. Good. Removing the temporary overrides once stable.
Priya (ml-infra): removing pinned overrides now.
Sam (oncall): re-checking traces after unpin — looks stable.
Maya (cust-success): lambda-retail asked for a short write-up and estimated RMSE / hallucination delta — will coordinate with Priya and Liam.
Aisha (support): filing a support postmortem summary and customer-facing FAQ draft.
Carlos (eng-mgr): good containment. Priya, please prepare a post-incident report with timeline, root cause (weighting + autoscaler coupling), impact (customers affected, duration, SLA delta), and action items (policy guardrails, rollout gating, better telemetry). Assign owners.
Priya (ml-infra): will do. Early action items: - add kill-switch test for price-led-fallback during rollout - add explicit coupling tests for region fallback + cost override - improve signal alerting thresholds to catch quality regressions earlier - add a canary exposure cap for newly introduced cost weights.
Maya (cust-success): sharing next update with customers in 2 hours.
Sam (oncall): closing pager for now — moving to monitoring state. If anything flips, @priya please re-pager.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — routing optimizer rollback + policy disabled + overrides applied. Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 at 2026-02-19T00:40:12Z.
Priya (ml-infra): assigning postmortem ticket: PM-2213344556 to myself. Will invite Liam, Carlos, Sam, Aisha, Maya.
Liam (prod-eng): noted. I'll add the PR diffs and perf traces.
Aisha (support): +1 on customer FAQ draft, will share in #support-customer-docs.
Carlos (eng-mgr): thanks team. Good ops and rapid mitigation. Follow-up due EOD tomorrow.
Maya (cust-success): customers updated and appreciative for quick rollback.
Priya (ml-infra): final note: we should add a unit test in optimizer harness that simulates sudden capacity shifts + cost weight to prevent similar emergent behaviour.
Sam (oncall): good call. Back to standby. :eyes:
